title: Project schema and scaffold for Agents and Missions

scope.project_contract: Schema-v1 project configs accept an optional missions path collection while retaining legacy v1 compatibility.
scope.scaffold: New front-desk projects include a project-relative missions directory and a deterministic defineMission-based Mission example.
scope.packaging: Mission references are included in governed package file collection and project hashes.
scope.runtime: The generated Mission validates against the public Mission contract and remains zero-credential under the local-fixture model.

verification.repaired_review_defect: Generated Mission was initially decorative and non-conforming; it now uses defineMission with a complete versioned Mission object and scaffold tests validate the emitted source through validateMission.

acceptance_coverage: New project creates a deterministic Mission definition under missions/.
Generated Mission validates against the public Mission contract.
Mission path references are source-bound and included in package hashing.
Legacy schema-v1 projects without missions remain valid.
Existing-project adoption, resume, rollback, and dirty-worktree protections remain covered.
Local simulator remains zero-credential and local-fixture based.
remaining_gate_requirements: CI execution evidence required by the Local + CI environment gate
Hosted Atlas Cloud, provider sandbox, staging and production evidence required by later programme gates
Whole-product, capacity, usage/cost, billing, commercial and independent certification evidence required by later programme gates
verdict: ATLAS-BMR2-P3-001 is LOCAL_PROVEN but remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL because the required CI evidence is unavailable. The local implementation satisfies the project/schema/scaffold acceptance surface without claiming hosted or whole-product readiness.
